done_definition: Project/Jinli/services/runtime/api_server.py: FastAPI/uvicorn HTTP transport exposing POST /turn and GET /healthz, fully driven by injected turn orchestrator and service registry snapshots — no LLM, no network calls, no daemon lifecycle
Project/Jinli/services/runtime/client.py: DaemonClient (POST /turn) with structured errors, configurable timeout, and explicit offline/degraded surfacing

Project/Jinli/services/runtime/tests/test_client.py: 18 new tests covering online success, manifest_id/turn_id round-trip, gate_passed/degraded flags, service_evidence enumeration, transport errors, timeout, and recovery hint messages

Project/Jinli/services/runtime/daemon.py: JinliDaemon extended with _start_api_server and _stop_api_server lifecycle hooks; daemon owns the uvicorn server lifecycle, port chosen at start, endpoint URL written into daemon state for the client to consume

.trae/scripts/jinli-runtime-turn.ps1: New -Mode parameter (lite|full), defaults to daemon HTTP client path, exposes -UseCompat as explicit opt-in to the legacy soul-core path so the compat shim remains first-class callable
WP02 baseline 82/82 tests still pass; 18 new client tests pass; total 100/100 in 63.70s; zero regressions

Live smoke: jinli-system.ps1 start → jinli-runtime-turn.ps1 -Mode lite -Text 'health probe' -Json returns manifest_id + turn_id, gate_passed=true, degraded=false, 11 services online, fallback_used=false
Offline smoke: with daemon stopped, the same command produces a clear error message naming the cause and listing recovery hints (start daemon / -UseCompat)
